messages:
Samantha CS: Heads up — Veridian AI (Tiana) just opened an intake asking to onboard a custom 30B domain-adapted model for healthcare claims summarization into our Private offering. They need PHI handling, on-prem option, and evaluation against their labeled set.
Tiana Hsu - Veridian AI: thanks! we want the model to run in our VPC with customer KMS/HSM. data is PHI (medical notes) — can you outline what you need from us for safety and a test eval?
Raj (SE): we can do Private with VPC + KMS. Quick Q: is the model custom (you trained it) or do you want us to host a 3rd-party open model fine-tuned on your data?
Tiana Hsu - Veridian AI: it's our fine-tuned checkpoint (we own weights). prefer private deploy. target throughput ~50 req/s, p95 latency <300ms for 512-token summaries.
Maria (ML ops): ok. we'll need: (1) model artifact (HF format + config), (2) sample eval set (50-100 labeled cases), (3) prompts + expected outputs and failure modes, (4) training/validation distribution notes. Also need a small synthetic PHI-free sample for staging.
Ben (Security): tagging this as compliance-impacting. We require a data processing agreement addendum and evidence of PHI handling controls. HSM + customer KMS is fine, but we'll need to validate key access flows and audit logs.
onboard-bot: Intake form submitted: https://redwood.app/onboard/intake/2165432100 — please attach model artifact and eval dataset there.
Samantha CS: FYI renewal for Veridian is in ~8 weeks and they're mentally scoped around compliance before renewal. If we can't show progress, renewal risk goes up — CS asks for a fast triage.
Raj (SE): initial capacity estimate: to meet 50 req/s p95<300ms we recommend 2x A100 nodes on Dedicated-equivalent topology in Private; we'll produce an options table (Dedicated vs on-prem) with cost delta.
Maria (ML ops): I'll spin up an eval run once they upload eval set. Proposed eval checklist: safety/sensitivity recall, hallucination metric (ROUGE + human spot checks), latency curve, and memory/kv-cache behavior.
Tiana Hsu - Veridian AI: timeline: can deliver model + eval set by next Wednesday. need an NDA addendum signed — send me the doc.
Ben (Security): I'll prepare the compliance checklist and NDA addendum. action: Ben to share DPA addendum by EOD today.
Samantha CS: Action items: Ben -> DPA addendum (EOD), Raj -> capacity/options doc (48h), Maria -> eval harness scaffold (48h), Tiana -> upload artifacts (by Wed). I'll follow up in 48h and update renewal tracker. :thumbsup: 
Raj (SE): sharing a minimal example of the private deploy config for their infra:
```json
{
  "deployment_mode": "private",
  "vpc": "vpc-xxxx",
  "kms": "customer-kms",
  "nodes": 2,
  "gpu": "A100-80GB"
}
```
Samantha CS: Thanks everyone — looping in legal for DPA sign. Tiana if anything changes ping me here. :wave:
